 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news More than seven million beneficiaries in the U.S. are to get their next monthly payment from the Social Security Administration.
 FINN GOMEZ U.S. benefits The Social Security Admin is sending out benefits today, Friday, October 30: who gets a payment?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Oct 30th, 2026 11:57 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Millions of benefits recipients in the U.S. are today being sent their latest monthly payment by the Social Security Administration (SSA).
 Who gets paid by the Social Security Admin today, Friday, October 30?
 Beneficiaries of the Supplemental Security Income scheme (SSI) are due to be issued their money for November 2026. 
 SSI is typically distributed on the first of each month, but November’s payment has been brought forward as the month begins on a Sunday. 
 Who is eligible for SSI in the U.S.?
 A needs-based program with around 7.3 million recipients, per the SSA’s latest figures, SSI is for low-income, low-resource Americans who are over the age of 65 or have a disability .
 Unlike the SSA’s Social Security scheme - which pays retirement, disability and survivor benefits to some 71.6 million people nationwide - eligibility for SSI does not depend on a claimant’s employment history .
 To find out more about SSI’s eligibility criteria , check out this information on the SSA website.
 How much are SSI benefits?
 Ave. payment as of September 2026 : $735.86 
 Max. individual payment in 2026: $994 
 Max. payment for couples in 2026: $1,491 
 Max. essential-person payment in 2026: $498 
 Supplementary state payments
 Some SSI beneficiaries can get a supplementary monthly payment from their state . Find out more about the states that provide this additional money on the SSA website .
 When is the 2027 COLA announced?
 Earlier in October, the SSA announced that recipients of SSI will get a 3.6% rise in their monthly payments in 2027 . This will see the maximum individual benefit increase to $1,029 per month, while couples will be able to claim a payment of up to $1,544 per month.
 The agency’s latest annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) will come into effect starting with benefits paid out for January . For SSI beneficiaries, next year’s opening payment is set for Thursday, December 31, 2026.
 How does the Social Security Admin pay out benefits?
 Direct deposit 
 SSI beneficiaries can supply the SSA with their bank details at 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office .
 Direct Express 
 Benefits can be paid onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for recipients who do not have a bank account. Sign up at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213 , or at a Social Security office.
